patchnotes.features: Security and economy hardening. Fixed a data-loss bug where partial profile updates could overwrite unrelated fields, and made insert retries tolerate more database error codes. Full-table scans are now paginated so large servers no longer spike memory. Prestige correctly scales mine production again, barrier unlocks use per-barrier tier gates, shop and settings buttons use opaque IDs, and activity tracking no longer slows commands down. All money math now uses overflow-safe helpers.

Aligned the infrastructure with VivacityAPI and introduced a shared command layer so prefix and slash commands run the same implementation. Normalized gameplay data keys, added player profiles, and removed a committed service-account credential from the repository.

Added the settings command, richer idle-cash overviews, and improved manager hiring and overview flows. Hardened runtime scheduling and startup validation, and added sanity checks for command loading.
Reduced database costs and added global error handling so unexpected errors no longer crash the bot.
Major data-layer rework with a new database manager, leaderboard, and improved work and upgrade flows. Added premium content and boosters.
Bot release! Idle Miner Tycoon in your Discord chat with mines, shafts, elevators, warehouses, managers, and barriers.
